description: This file defines a Twig extension class `DebugExtension` that adds a `dump` function for debugging purposes within Twig templates. It determines if dumping should produce safe HTML output based on environment and configuration, and implements the dump logic that outputs variable information if debugging is enabled.

classes.name: Twig\Extension\DebugExtension
classes.description: A final class extending Twig's Extension system to add a dump function for debugging templates.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Defines and returns the Twig functions added by this extension, including logic to determine if dump output is safe HTML based on environment and PHP configuration.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: A static internal method that outputs the dump of variables or context, if debugging is active, capturing output and returning it as a string.
